# platform-orchestrator_module_draft_test (Resource)

Captures one exact reviewed Module Draft revision for one Environment. This retains immutable test material without publishing a Module Version, reserving SemVer or executing a deployment. Use its module_uuid and id in a deployment's draft_test_snapshots map. Capture and publication remain separate actions; destroying this resource only forgets the reference and retains test history.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "platform-orchestrator_module_draft_test" "reviewed" {
  project_id                = "example"
  env_id                    = "development"
  module_id                 = "storage"
  draft_id                  = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
  capture_key               = "storage-first-review"
  expected_resource_version = 1
  reason                    = "Capture the exact implementation reviewed before execution"
}

resource "platform-orchestrator_deployment" "test" {
  project_id = "example"
  env_id     = "development"
  draft_test_snapshots = {
    (platform-orchestrator_module_draft_test.reviewed.module_uuid) = platform-orchestrator_module_draft_test.reviewed.id
  }
  manifest = jsonencode({
    workloads = {}
    shared = {
      storage = { type = "storage" }
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `capture_key` (String) Stable identity for this capture intent and its retries. Use a new key when starting another test session or recreating its Environment.
- `draft_id` (String)
- `env_id` (String)
- `expected_resource_version` (Number) Exact reviewed authoring revision to capture. Save and review edits before changing this value; the server rejects stale revisions.
- `module_id` (String)
- `project_id` (String)
- `reason` (String) Audited reason for capturing this exact test.

### Read-Only

- `environment_uuid` (String)
- `id` (String) Immutable executable test snapshot UUID, distinct from Draft and published Version UUIDs.
- `module_uuid` (String)
- `project_uuid` (String)
- `resource_type_version` (Number)
- `resource_type_version_uuid` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import platform-orchestrator_module_draft_test.reviewed example/development/storage/22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222/storage-first-review
```
